Thanks for the report — this is a documentation bug, not something on your end. The "Running locally" section (step 5) tells readers to run `npm run serve`, but no such script exists in `package.json`, which is why you see "Missing script: serve". The README needs to be updated to reference the actual start script used to run the built API (e.g. whatever `npm start` or the correct script name is), so the local setup instructions work as written.
